summary: Steep residential kerb, about 13% grade, with homes tight along the west side.
reasons: Residential street, 2P and No Stopping signs

drivers.seclusion: Houses line the west kerb at 11-20 m, with flats opposite; no buffer of bush or park.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with a few parked cars; room to stop, but the slope is too steep.
drivers.convention: Cars park here; 2P applies Mon-Fri 9-5 and No Stopping signs mark the corner.

flags: Steep: about 13% from 35 m to 43 m elevation over 63 m

sun_shade: Patchy shade from street trees and gardens.
